verdict_reason: All 30 sampled tiles are one single property: the Sofitel Legend Metropole Hanoi at 15 Ngo Quyen, and its own pavements. Multiple independent confirmations rather than a vibe: the 'Le Salon' shopping arcade with Bally, Cartier, Salvatore Ferragamo and Louis Vuitton boutiques; the Hermes Paris store on the Opera Wing; the boutique row with Sergio Rossi and 'L'Ep(icerie)'; the palm-fringed pool courtyard framed by the white arcaded Bamboo Bar wing (three separate frames, colour and B&W); the historic wing's green louvred shutters; Le Beaulieu's dining room; the glass-vaulted conservatory bar; and the hotel's signature pair of vintage Citroen Traction Avant cars parked at the Opera Wing entrance. The caveat worth recording: this is effectively one photographer's single hotel stay (one contiguous id range 5415-5420), so the pile is 'genuine' as a place but not as evidence that many people photograph this point. Also note the pin is ~80-100 m off - it sits by the Opera House, while the actual subject is the Metropole on Ngo Quyen - so the place label should be the hotel, not the Opera House.
place_if_genuine: Sofitel Legend Metropole Hanoi, 15 Ngo Quyen, Hanoi

photos.place: Sofitel Legend Metropole Hanoi, 15 Ngo Quyen, Hanoi
photos.evidence: Night view across a lit turquoise swimming pool at the tall cream-rendered wing of a colonial-era hotel with its chamfered corner, uplit facade, festive lanterns and arcaded ground-floor bar - the Metropole's pool courtyard looking at the Opera Wing, matching the daylight versions in 5419249112 and 5420153082.

photos.place: Sofitel Legend Metropole Hanoi, 15 Ngo Quyen, Hanoi
photos.evidence: Close-up of a black rotary 'candlestick-style' replica telephone with a notepad and pencil on a dark timber desk with a toile-patterned surface behind. No location cue in the object itself; assigned to the hotel because it sits inside the same contiguous upload from the same stay in which the hotel is repeatedly and verifiably identified, and matches the heritage-wing room dressing.

photos.place: Sofitel Legend Metropole Hanoi, 15 Ngo Quyen, Hanoi
photos.evidence: Hotel bedroom: dark upholstered headboard, floral-sprig wallpaper, twin bedside sconces, white duvet with four stacked pillows, framed print and a niche with candle. Heritage-wing room decor; identified by session context, not by any visible sign.

photos.place: Sofitel Legend Metropole Hanoi, 15 Ngo Quyen, Hanoi
photos.evidence: Tight frame of a white-rendered facade: one casement window with dark green louvred shutters, a small planter on the sill, moulded architrave and a banded/rusticated course below - the Metropole historic wing's signature white-and-green-shutter elevation, the same envelope seen in the street frames 5418618875 and 5419617379.

photos.place: Sofitel Legend Metropole Hanoi, 15 Ngo Quyen, Hanoi
photos.evidence: Glass-vaulted conservatory with white-painted arched and fanlight joinery, dark bentwood-style chairs and small tables, guests seated - the hotel's glazed garden-side bar/verandah, the same room as 5419233340, 5419246018 and (in B&W) 5419577083.

photos.place: Sofitel Legend Metropole Hanoi, 15 Ngo Quyen, Hanoi
photos.evidence: Formal French dining room: white linen, red-upholstered chairs, wrought-iron chandeliers, twin-candle wall sconces, tall shuttered windows with roman blinds onto greenery, chequered marble floor - the Le Beaulieu restaurant room, repeated in the B&W frames 5419558559, 5419596523, 5419621981.

photos.place: Le Salon arcade, Sofitel Legend Metropole Hanoi, 15 Ngo Quyen, Hanoi
photos.evidence: A marble-floored shopping corridor with projecting black-and-gold signs legible as 'Le Salon', 'BALLY', 'Cartier', 'Salvatore Ferragamo' and 'LOUIS VUITTON' at the far end, with a red fire cabinet on the left wall. That is the Metropole's Le Salon arcade - this exact tenant mix in a hotel arcade is specific to the Metropole.

photos.place: Sofitel Legend Metropole Hanoi (La Terrasse corner, Ngo Quyen at Ly Thai To), Hanoi
photos.evidence: Street corner of a white colonial hotel block with dark green louvred shutters and balustraded balconies, a deep green awning over a pavement cafe full of seated guests, lantern-style wall lamps, brick-paved sidewalk and zebra crossing - the Metropole's corner terrace cafe on Ngo Quyen.

photos.place: Sofitel Legend Metropole Hanoi Opera Wing boutiques, Hanoi
photos.evidence: White boutique frontage under a colonial-style upper floor with green shutters and balustrades; fascias readable as 'HERMES', '...ROSSI' (Sergio Rossi) and 'L'Ep...' (L'Epicerie du Metropole), plus a chalkboard A-frame, ornate black lamp standard and planters. This is the Metropole Opera Wing retail row.

photos.place: Sofitel Legend Metropole Hanoi, 15 Ngo Quyen, Hanoi
photos.evidence: Bronze antiques on a glass vitrine shelf against a white curtain: a boy riding a buffalo, a gilt-robed seated monk on a black plinth, small animal figures. An antiques display case; placed at the hotel because it is the same shop window shot again in 5419226212/5419605807 within the hotel arcade sequence, but the case itself carries no name.

photos.place: Sofitel Legend Communal areas, Sofitel Legend Metropole Hanoi, 15 Ngo Quyen, Hanoi
photos.evidence: Breakfast room with coffered/stepped ceiling cornice, ceiling fans, arched openings, cane-and-timber armchairs at small tables, guests eating, tall windows onto foliage. Metropole public room, identified by session context and matching millwork rather than a sign.

photos.evidence: Large buffet restaurant with a copper-hooded show-cooking station, ceiling fans, wrought-iron chandeliers, framed pictures on ochre walls and staff in uniform behind the counters. Hotel buffet dining room in the same stay sequence.

photos.evidence: Hotel bathroom: marble vanity with undermount basin, oval dark-framed mirror, two shaded wall lamps, folded towel and toiletries, louvred door at right. No identifying mark; assigned by session context.

photos.place: Sofitel Legend Metropole Hanoi, 15 Ngo Quyen, Hanoi
photos.evidence: Bedroom with the same floral-sprig wallpaper and framed print as 5418561459, white bed with a red bolster cushion, dark curtain and a dark timber floor. Same room type, same stay.

photos.place: Sofitel Legend Metropole Hanoi, 15 Ngo Quyen, Hanoi
photos.evidence: Lounge/lobby bar with a gilt-panelled ceiling, patterned carpet on parquet, cane-backed armchairs round a pedestal table, dark joinery, a service trolley of cups and potted palms. Hotel public room in the same sequence.

photos.evidence: Antique-shop window display of polychrome and gilt wooden mandarin/guardian figures, a lion-dog and an open book of old photographs on gravel. An arcade shop window; no name visible, placed by session context.

photos.place: Sofitel Legend Metropole Hanoi, 15 Ngo Quyen, Hanoi

photos.place: Sofitel Legend Metropole Hanoi (Le Beaulieu), 15 Ngo Quyen, Hanoi

This is the Metropole Opera Wing's Hermes frontage.

photos.place: Sofitel Legend Metropole Hanoi entrance, 15 Ngo Quyen, Hanoi

The Metropole keeps exactly these period Citroens outside its entrance.
